item_name: Rothco Wide Mouth Mechanics Tool Bag
item_short_desc: Inspired by the classic service mechanic's tool bag, this wide mouth version is a great alternative to a traditional metal toolbox. Crafted with rugged heavyweight canvas, it offers durability for storing all your tools. With a U-shaped zipper design, it provides easy access to the interior, while 8 organizer pockets help keep your tools organized. 2 outside snap pockets offer additional storage for small items, and a hard plastic bottom insert ensures stability when the bag is open.
description: Inspired by the classic service mechanic's tool bag, this wide mouth version is a great alternative to a traditional metal toolbox.
